This note describes how a coherent set of UBL example documents is created and maintained: a fictional world of organisations that exchange UBL documents with each other, and for every value in every example the reason why it fits the semantic meaning of its element in that context.
Notices
This is a proposal draft, prepared outside the OASIS UBL Technical Committee. It has not been contributed to, reviewed by or approved by the TC, and it is not an OASIS work product. It may be proposed to the TC as a contribution for a Committee Note.
Source and history: https://github.com/kduvekot/ubl-examples.
The layout uses the OASIS DocBook publishing stylesheets (spec-0.9), as used by the OASIS UBL TC. UBL is an OASIS Standard and ISO/IEC 19845.
